name: R. E. Spurrier
role: Northern Pacific station agent at Little Missouri, 1884
bio: R. E. Spurrier was the Northern Pacific agent whose name ran at the foot of the railroad time table in the Cow Boy from February to August 1884. In April 1884 a railroad auditor examined his accounts and the paper reported them all right. In May 1884 he shipped his household goods to Spokane Falls and was to leave as soon as a relief agent arrived, and that month the new agent, Mr. Brinker, arrived to relieve him.
